user_hypothesis: Prefer a mutant if at least one peptide position has a sufficiently large predicted RMSF decrease.

score.formula: max over all 9 peptide positions of (RMSF_parent - RMSF_mutant)
score.unit: Angstrom, original predicted RMSF physical scale
score.sign: Larger score is hypothesized to indicate stronger binding; retain signed values, including all-negative profiles.
score.sites: All nine peptide residues, including the mutated position; geometry and sequence verified against archived metadata.
score.threshold: No absolute threshold calibrated or optimized; analyze continuous ranking and archive every candidate.

inherited_fixed_choices.SPR_rule: Pettmann original Methods: constrained KD >20 uM uses constrained, otherwise Bmax-fitted. No score-based source selection.
inherited_fixed_choices.label: pKD=-log10(KD in M); candidate-minus-parent pKD within the same source study and assay at 37C, then median across studies for a duplicate candidate.
inherited_fixed_choices.batch: Published study/protocol matched means; individual run/batch pairing not reported.
inherited_fixed_choices.censoring: No bound is treated as exact. Inherited label censoring is checked; any censored item is retained separately, not silently dropped.

primary_analysis.unit: 26 unique single mutants: 13 per TCR panel; parents excluded from correlations.
primary_analysis.outcome: archived within-study parent-relative delta_pKD, larger means stronger binding
primary_analysis.statistic: Descriptive Spearman correlation of max RMSF drop versus delta_pKD on all 26 primary-template single mutants, and each 13-candidate panel separately.
primary_analysis.pooled_caution: Two TCR panels are not 26 independent systems; pooled value is descriptive and panels must remain visible.

sensitivity_analysis.scope: All five template panels x all three SPR versions; same single mutant candidate scope within each panel; per-study correlations also retained.
sensitivity_analysis.multiple_mutants: Two A6 double mutants shown separately with raw scores and labels; never merge into primary n.

interpretation_limits: Small, retrospectively assembled affinity panels, not complete mutational libraries; cannot estimate screening hit rate.
Only one primary candidate is slightly stronger than its parent and all A6 mutants are weaker: cannot establish high-affinity design success.
Fixed parental backbone and historical 2431 no-ITrace joint checkpoint; not the manuscript 2430 checkpoint.
Correlation cannot establish a causal RMSF-to-affinity mechanism, bound-to-unbound entropy change, or universal direction.
